# OMP Strata

> Profile, lifecycle tool and acceptance evidence for running the stock Oh My Pi (OMP) coding agent against
> a stock, local Strata inference server on one Windows 11 + RTX host. It forks neither project and adds no
> proxy: every download is pinned by URL, size and SHA-256; stock `setup.py` runs unmodified from verified
> local inputs; Strata binds to loopback behind an API key; stock OMP runs in an isolated profile with every
> model role on the local server and no cloud fallback. Python standard library only. Qualified and current (2026-11-07–08):
> stock Strata v0.2.12 (engine 0.1.58) + stock OMP 18.18.0 across the RTX PRO 6000 (plus its tuned-DFlash2 v0.2.12 alternate), the RTX 5090 262K default and 131K alternative, the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 pair and the Mac Studio route (plus its tuned-DFlash2 v0.2.12 alternate): on the
> RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 pair in `rtx3090-win-a` (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_S at the trained 262,144-token context, stock
> roles `--gpu-roles 0=main,1=helper` putting the RTX 4090 as Main staged last, manual layer split 24 `--layer-split 24`,
> stage dense-weight trim `--trim-stage-weights` (`strata.trim_stage_weights: true`), stock DFlash2 drafting alone
> via `strata.drafting: "dflash2"` (`--draft dflash2 --draft-model <root>\data\dflash2\qwen3.8-flash-next-dflash2.q4_0-selq4.pack --draft-fallback none --draft-conf 0.35 --draft-vocab <root>\data\dflash2\draft_vocab.bin`,
> packed offline during `install` by stock `tools/dflash2_pack.py` from pinned `incoai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-DFlash2` files
> with `STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE=1`), dropping `--pipeline-windows 2` and sizing the expert caches at 19.40 GiB on the RTX 3090
> and 17.90 GiB on the RTX 4090 on engine 0.1.58 vs 19.41 / 17.90 GiB on v0.2.11 `df2`, 19.41 / 18.31 GiB on v0.2.10 `df2` and 19.14 / 17.75 GiB on the v0.2.10
> `pw2` (`--pipeline-windows 2`) `env86g` multi-token prediction (MTP) alternative, with G17's near-limit task wall at
> 57.7 s vs 59.7 s on the v0.2.12 `env86g` rollback and 61.1 s on v0.2.11 `df2`, no batch slots, display on the RTX 4090, `strata.ple_io: "direct"` pinning stock
> `--ple-io direct` to keep the 26.8 GiB per-layer embedding (PLE) table on direct SSD reads, preserving the engine's
> 8,192 MiB automatic conversation cache with 22 parks in G19 and 28.21 GiB G10 Windows commit headroom of a 135.69 GiB limit with 65.74 GiB
> available RAM, and `strata.engine_env` pinning the engine's `sm_86` default table `sm86_table`, stock `gdn_stack` and two-pass QSA block selection `select_two_pass` (`STRATA_SELECT_TWO_PASS=1`; the `env86gt` id drops `-parking` only to stay within the 120-character profile-id limit, with the same `strata.stock_tips`),
> which in three paired cold starts against the v0.2.12 `env86g` pair profile passed all 96 checks with 200K cold TTFT at 0.976 (`[0.981, 0.977, 0.970]`), and passed all 14
> measured gates in the 2026-11-07 requalification chain at `57dcd18` (`953a31f`) with 55.3-55.5 s restart readiness, lowest available RAM 57.00 GiB in G18L, G24 15/18, pilot 6/6 and batch wall 968 s;
> `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-df2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-env86gt-strata0.2.12-omp18.18.0`;

> directly comparable across OMP versions). Protocol counters (including malformed arguments and calls
> without results) and timeouts are 0 across all qualified server profiles; all task failures stay counted.
> Scored batch walls are 522 s on the current PRO v0.2.12 `df2` DFlash2 profile (v0.2.12 `df2tuned` alternate: 581 s;
> v0.2.11 `df2` rollback: 627 s; v0.2.11 `batchmtp`: 549 s), 787 s on the RTX 5090 262K `kvvram-kvgrow-envg` default
> (v0.2.11 rollback: 843 s; unqualified v0.2.12 `envgt` draft: 761 s), 726 s on the RTX 5090 131K v0.2.12 alternative
> (v0.2.10 rollback: 742 s; unqualified v0.2.11 draft: 758 s) and 968 s on the current pair `df2` `env86gt` two-pass
> profile (v0.2.12 `env86g` rollback: 906 s; v0.2.11 `df2`: 896 s; v0.2.10 `df2`: 916 s); these are not isolated decode
> latency. v0.2.12 ships its engine (0.1.58) as a separately versioned CUDA 13 component tarball staged into
> `runtime\strata\engine\`, reusing `locks/strata-python-cp313-win_amd64-strata0.2.11.txt` (26 hash-locked wheels).
> On `rtx3090-win-a`, engine 0.1.58's stage order was admitted at `a5989fe` after the 2026-11-07 pair measurement:
> stock roles (`--gpu-roles 0=main,1=helper`, RTX 4090 as Main staged last; layers 0-23 on the RTX 3090 with a 19.40 GiB
> expert cache on engine 0.1.58 `df2` vs 19.41 GiB on v0.2.11 and v0.2.10 `df2` under `--layer-split 24 --trim-stage-weights`, and 24-47 on the RTX 4090 with 17.90 GiB on
> engine 0.1.58 and 0.1.57 `df2`, 18.31 GiB on v0.2.10 `df2`, and 17.75 GiB on v0.2.10 `pw2`).
> The earlier v0.2.11 + OMP 18.16.0 [PRO batch-MTP kvvram-envpg](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-batchmtp-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-parking-strata0.2.11-omp18.16.0/qualification.json),

> keeps the display on the RTX 4090; its
> [earlier predecessor](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-131k-pw2-strata0.1.42-omp18.8.9/qualification.json)
> requires moving the display back to the RTX 3090. Single-card RTX 3090 profiles are not rollbacks
> while both cards are installed: they name GPU 0, now the RTX 4090. Earlier qualified history: on the RTX PRO 6000, stock Strata v0.1.41 + stock OMP
> 18.8.6 with the same choices at 262,144 tokens, then at 131,072 tokens, then the same choices on v0.1.40.3 + OMP
> 18.8.4, then OMP 18.8.3, then v0.1.40.2 + 18.8.0 without them; on the RTX 5090, v0.1.41 + OMP 18.8.6, then
> v0.1.40.3 + OMP 18.8.4, then stock Strata v0.1.34 + stock OMP 18.4.10, which also stays qualified on the
> single-card RTX 3090 and RTX 4090. Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by the
> Oh My Pi maintainers, the Strata maintainer, Qwen or NVIDIA.

## Install

- From a checkout, with the current candidate profile: `validate` → `fetch` → `install` → `keygen` →
  `start` → `launch-omp` → `stop` (`py -3 scripts\omp_strata.py <command> --profile <profile> --root <root>`).
- One integration root per candidate; nothing is written to the user's normal OMP configuration or to
  `%APPDATA%\Strata`.

## Boundaries

- Supported: the qualified profiles under `profiles/` (Windows 11, a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5090, RTX 3090
  or RTX 4090, or the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 layer-split pair; every other profile is a draft or a rollback installation),
  text only, single user, loopback only.
- Remote use: the Mac Studio's current qualified route,
  `client-rtxpro6000-262k-df2-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-strata0.2.12-omp18.18.0`, runs stock OMP 18.18.0 through an
  SSH local forward to `win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-df2-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-parking-strata0.2.12-omp18.18.0`,
  the PRO's current v0.2.12 262K `df2` DFlash2 profile (G23 pass on 2026-11-07 at `243290e`: missing key refused before
  launch, wrong key 401, health RTT 5.9-7.4 ms and stream TTFT 0.247 s; tunnel drop failed the turn in flight with the
  prior transcript preserved, nonce recall passed after tunnel reopen 0.87 s, client restart 0.79 s and verified server
  restart 2.56 s, and a one-turn `launch-omp` smoke answered `ROUTE OK` with owned stop).
  Its qualified non-current alternate, `client-rtxpro6000-262k-df2tuned-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-strata0.2.12-omp18.18.0`,
  reaches the PRO's v0.2.12 262K `df2tuned` tuned-pack alternate (G23 pass on 2026-11-08 at `2560f77`: missing key
  refused before launch, wrong key 401, health RTT 12.1-16.1 ms and stream TTFT 0.317 s; tunnel drop failed the turn in
  flight with the prior transcript preserved, nonce recall passed after tunnel reopen 0.90 s, client restart 0.86 s and
  verified server restart 1.61 s, and a one-turn `launch-omp` smoke answered `ROUTE OK` with owned stop).
  Its qualified rollback, `client-rtxpro6000-262k-df2-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-strata0.2.11-omp18.16.0`, reaches the
  PRO's v0.2.11 262K `df2` DFlash2 rollback (G23 pass on 2026-11-06 at `b812df9`: missing key refused before launch, wrong
  key 401, health RTT 6.0-10.1 ms and stream TTFT 0.270 s; tunnel drop failed the turn in flight with the prior
  transcript preserved, nonce recall passed after tunnel reopen 1.83 s, client restart 1.11 s and verified server
  restart 2.34 s, and a one-turn `launch-omp` smoke answered `ROUTE OK` with owned stop). The 0.2.11 `batchmtp`, 0.2.10 `kvvram-envpg`,
  0.2.9 `kvvram-envpg`, 0.2.9 batch-MTP base, 0.2.8 batch-MTP, 0.2.8 `slots4-parking`, 0.2.7, 0.2.3, 0.2.1, 0.1.44.1,
  0.1.43.1, 0.1.43 and 0.1.42 262K routes and `client-rtxpro6000-strata0.1.41-omp18.8.6` 131K route stay earlier history.
- Not supported: images, remote clients other than those qualified current, alternate and rollback Mac-to-RTX PRO 6000 routes, other
  operating systems, durable engine state across restarts, multiple tenants. Comparisons with other runtimes are
  separate, comparison-only tools.
- Security: loopback only, API key required on every model, control and metrics route, key in a user-only
  file, ambient provider credentials scrubbed from OMP's environment, no telemetry. Not a sandbox, a
  multi-tenant service or an egress firewall.
